title: Grandpa Is Nine Feet TALL 📏
premise: In a town where saying you're proud of someone makes you grow an inch, my quiet hardware-store grandpa is nine feet tall and has never said it to me.
twist: He says it to anyone in town who fixes something with their own hands, one pencil mark per inch on his door frame, and I've never fixed a thing myself, so I fix the stuck back door, he says it to my face, and I say it back and grow my first inch.
world: A bright little hardware store on a sunny main street: mint shelves of bins, a honey-wood counter, a key machine, an upturned crate behind the counter, a front window full of sun and a back doorway whose cream frame is covered in pencil marks.
